Maya: Quick sync: leadership wants a razor checklist for GA acceptance covering SLA, observability, docs, support, pricing. Need owners and explicit gates by EOD.
Devin: Ill own SLA + canary policy. Proposing Standard p99 <=1s, err <0.5%; Enterprise p99 <=600ms, err <0.1%.
Sasha: Monitoring will do dashboards, synth probes, and runbooks. Need SLO numbers to wire alerts.
Rami: Docs will produce quickstart, migration notes, code snippets (py/js). Draft by Thu.
Karen: Support will publish playbook + train 2 agents. Need runbook links to finish.
Liam: Finance: SKU list and quota tests. Decision: embeddings billed as separate units?
Maya: OK decision: embeddings = separate units for GA.
Devin: Canary draft: 5% for 24h, 25% for 24h, 100% after 48h if stable. Rollback on token-error-rate >0.5% sustained 5m.
Sasha: Will add warming traffic and synthetic suites.
Maya: If any gate not green by Mon 09:00 we defer GA 1 week. Owners, escalate early.
Devin: Opening SLA + canary PR.
Rami: PR link to follow.
Karen: Training invites sent.
Liam: SKU catalog out tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks, posting tracker tonight.
